background: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group is Japan's largest trust bank, the holding company of Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, whose business is asset management, custody, pensions and real-estate services alongside conventional lending and deposits.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A- on average, both on a stable outlook. Capital is the weak spot against Asian banks: CET1 of 11.1% is in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.2% below the peer median. Both are drifting lower, with CET1 down 1.0 points and leverage down 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2025, in figures to 30 Jun 2026.
